card.name: Verbs after prohibitions or warnings
card.fires_on: The verb or noun right after a prohibition or harm cue ("do not", "prevent", "prohibition of", "result from"), just before the bad or invalid thing is named. Often in 'do not use/administer if...' inspection warnings.
